notes: Cats: the Régionale bank's Viticulture & Winemaking (its 31 cellar stems) and Winemaking Techniques (50 stems, all cellar); the Village bank's Viticulture & Winemaking (14 cellar stems) and Wine Fundamentals, which holds the Court's Certified chemistry (acids, pH, sugars, sulphur free and bound, malolactic). Chapters: the Régionale chapter vin and the two Village chapters. Regions: only the two the Court names for vessels, botti in Piemonte and barriques in Rioja. No grapes. Techniques: the winery and colour groups of the roster, one per Court row (rosé methods, carbonic, whole bunch, extraction, malolactic, oak, lees and bâtonnage, chaptalisation and acidification, assemblage, fining and sulphur, fermentation and yeast). Service table faults: the bottling row's sulphur and tartrate rows and the oxidation and refermentation faults are what the Court's cause and effect looks like at the table.
